name: Marcus Vance

education.degree: B.S. in Computer Science & Applied Mathematics

projects.title: HyperQueue - Distributed Task Scheduling Broker
projects.description: Architected a high-throughput job queue and task scheduler in Go and Redis with worker heartbeat monitoring, exponential backoff retries, and dead-letter queue management. Implemented REST and WebSocket monitoring dashboard.
highlights: Benchmark tested at 12,000 tasks/second with sub-15ms acknowledgement latency under simulated packet loss.
Engineered distributed locking using Redis Redlock algorithm to prevent duplicate worker executions.

projects.title: Campus Marketplace API with Microservices
projects.description: Built async microservice backend with FastAPI, PostgreSQL, and RabbitMQ message broker for item listings, messaging, and Stripe payment webhook integrations.
highlights: Wrote 95% code coverage test suite using Pytest and Testcontainers.
Optimized slow multi-table joins using composite database indexes and Redis read caching, reducing P99 latency by 64%.

experience.description: Built transaction audit log endpoints in FastAPI. Reduced database query latency by creating database indexes and connection pooling in SQLAlchemy.

strengths: Deep understanding of concurrency, async I/O, and distributed messaging
Strong database design, indexing strategies, and SQL optimization
Obsession with automated testing, CI, and clean API design
growth_areas: Kubernetes cluster administration and multi-region failover
